decisions.rationale: Standing carrion crow, wings folded, head turned slightly to the viewer; both legs and the heavy beak are separate and readable.

Perched crow, 0.46 m tall, 2,364 triangles on a small rig with Perch and Peck clips (Azure concept b, TRELLIS b-s6111). Cooked with cook_crow.py: a distance-weighted rig, 256 px textures, 99,112 bytes. Clip strips reviewed frame by frame (anim-review2).
limitations: Feathers are a baked TRELLIS texture at 256 px; no separate feather cards.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

decisions.rationale: Presentation-only crow flocks on stubble fields, chapels, gibbets and the Echo Well: they peck and perch, take off when the hero comes within 10 m, fly off and land again once the hero is 34 m away; perched and flight models swap at take-off and landing. Never in snapshots, saves or rules.
limitations: At 18-40 m a crow is 10-20 px; it reads as a black bird, not a detailed one.
